name: intercom
label: Intercom
description: Customer messaging platform for sales, marketing, and support

accessToken.label: Access Token
accessToken.description: Find your token in Settings > Integrations > Developer Hub > Your App > Authentication.

add-note-to-user.label: Add Note

addNoteToConversation.label: Add note to conversation
addNoteToConversation.description: Add a note (for other admins) to an existing conversation

add-or-remove-tag-on-contact.label: Add/Remove Tag on Contact
add-or-remove-tag-on-contact.description: Attach or remove a tag from a specific contact.

add-or-remove-tag-on-company.label: Add/Remove Tag on Company
add-or-remove-tag-on-company.description: Attach or remove a tag from a specific company.

add-or-remove-tag-on-conversation.label: Add/Remove Tag on Conversation
add-or-remove-tag-on-conversation.description: Attach or remove a tag from a specific conversation.

assignConversationAction.label: Assign conversation to an admin or a team
assignConversationAction.description: (Re)assign conversation to a specific admin or team.

assigneeId.label: Assignee ID
assigneeId.description: The ID of the admin or team to assign this conversation to

create-article.label: Create Article
create-article.description: Creates a new article in your Help Center.

create-conversation.label: Create Conversation
create-conversation.description: Creates a new conversation from a contact.

create-data-event.label: Create Data Event
create-data-event.description: Submits a data event for a contact.

eventName.label: Event Name
eventName.description: The name of the event that occurred.

createdAt.label: Created At
createdAt.description: When the event happened. Defaults to now if left empty.

metadata.label: Metadata
metadata.description: Optional key/value pairs describing the event.

create-ticket.label: Create Ticket

ticketProperties.label: Ticket Properties
ticketProperties.description: The values by name, as JSON.

createdAt.label: Created At
createdAt.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, such as 2026-01-02T10:00:00Z.

create-or-update-company.label: Create or Update Company
create-or-update-company.description: Creates a new company or updates an existing one (matched by Company ID).

companyId.label: Company ID
companyId.description: The company ID you have defined for the company. Cannot be updated later.

size.label: Size
size.description: The number of employees in this company.

monthlySpend.label: Monthly Spend
monthlySpend.description: How much revenue the company generates for your business (whole integers only).

remoteCreatedAt.label: Created At
remoteCreatedAt.description: The time the company was created by you.

create-or-update-lead.label: Create or Update Lead
create-or-update-lead.description: Create or update an Intercom lead.If an ID is provided, the lead will be updated.

createdAt.label: Created At
createdAt.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, such as 2026-01-02T10:00:00Z.

create-or-update-user.label: Create/Update User
create-or-update-user.description: Update a user within intercom given an email address.

createdAt.label: Created At
createdAt.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, such as 2026-01-02T10:00:00Z.

replyToConversation.label: Reply to conversation
replyToConversation.description: Reply (as an admin) to a conversation with a contact

send_message.label: Send Message
send_message.description: Send a message to a contact (only allowed by admins)

email_required_fields.label: Email Required Fields
email_required_fields.description: The values by name, as JSON.

create_conversation_without_contact_repl.label: Create Conversation Without Contact Reply
create_conversation_without_contact_repl.description: Whether a conversation should be opened in the inbox for the message without the contact replying. Defaults to false if not provided.

update-ticket.label: Update Ticket

ticketProperties.label: Ticket Properties
ticketProperties.description: The values by name, as JSON.

snoozedTill.label: Snoozed Until
snoozedTill.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, such as 2026-01-02T10:00:00Z.

find-company.label: Find Company

find-conversation.label: Find Conversation
find-conversation.description: Searches for conversations using various criteria

searchTerm.label: Search Term
searchTerm.description: Conversation ID, Assigned Admin, Team and Tag IDs only support Equals.

updateAfter.label: Update After
updateAfter.description: Intercom compares dates by calendar day in your workspace time zone.

updateBefore.label: Update Before
updateBefore.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, such as 2026-01-02T10:00:00Z.

find-conversation.afterResponse:
const found = response.conversations ?? [];
return {found: found.length > 0, conversation: found.length > 0 ? found[0] : {}};

find-or-create-company.label: Find or Create Company
find-or-create-company.description: Finds a company by Company ID or name, creating it if none is found.

companyId.label: Company ID
companyId.description: The company ID you have defined for the company. Used to look up and create.

name.label: Name
name.description: Used to look up by name when no Company ID is given, and when creating.

find-or-create-lead.label: Find or Create Lead
find-or-create-lead.description: Finds a lead by email, ID, or User ID, creating it if none is found.

get-conversation.label: Retrieve a Conversation
get-conversation.description: Retrieves a specific conversation by ID.

get_conversation_by_id.label: Get Conversation (by ID)
get_conversation_by_id.description: Gets a conversation and its messages by conversation ID.

conversationId.label: Conversation ID
conversationId.description: The Intercom conversation ID, for example from Search Conversations.

plainText.label: Plain Text Bodies
plainText.description: Return message bodies as plain text instead of HTML.

reply_to_conversation_by_id.label: Reply to Conversation (by ID)
reply_to_conversation_by_id.description: Posts an admin reply that the customer sees in a conversation.

body.label: Reply
body.description: The reply text. Simple HTML is allowed.

adminId.label: Admin ID
adminId.description: The admin who replies. Leave empty to reply as the admin who owns this connection (see List Admins).

attachmentUrls.label: Attachment URLs
attachmentUrls.description: Up to 10 public image URLs to attach.

add_note_to_conversation_by_id.label: Add Note to Conversation (by ID)
add_note_to_conversation_by_id.description: Adds an internal note, visible only to your team, to a conversation.

body.label: Note
body.description: The note text. Simple HTML is allowed.

adminId.label: Admin ID
adminId.description: The admin who writes the note. Leave empty to use the admin who owns this connection.

assign_conversation_by_id.label: Assign Conversation (by ID)
assign_conversation_by_id.description: Assigns a conversation to an admin or a team, or unassigns it.

assigneeId.label: Assignee ID
assigneeId.description: The admin or team ID. Use 0 to unassign.

adminId.label: Acting Admin ID
adminId.description: The admin who performs the assignment. Leave empty to use the admin who owns this connection.

tag_or_untag_record.label: Tag or Untag Record
tag_or_untag_record.description: Adds or removes a tag on a contact, conversation, company or ticket.

recordId.label: Record ID
recordId.description: The Intercom ID of the contact, conversation, company (Intercom company ID, not your Company ID) or ticket.

tagId.label: Tag ID
tagId.description: The tag ID from List Tags. Give either Tag ID or Tag Name.

tagName.label: Tag Name
tagName.description: The tag name (case-insensitive). Give either Tag ID or Tag Name.

remove.label: Remove Tag
remove.description: Turn on to remove the tag instead of adding it.

send_message_to_contact.label: Send Message to Contact
send_message_to_contact.description: Sends a new email or in-app message from an admin to one contact.

contactId.label: Contact ID
contactId.description: The Intercom contact ID. Give either Contact ID or Contact Email.

email.label: Contact Email
email.description: Used when no Contact ID is given. Fails if several contacts share this email.

body.label: Message
body.description: The message text. Simple HTML is allowed.

adminId.label: From Admin ID
adminId.description: The sending admin. Leave empty to send as the admin who owns this connection.

openConversation.label: Open Conversation Right Away
openConversation.description: Open a conversation in the inbox without waiting for the contact to reply.

create_ticket_by_type_id.label: Create Ticket (by Type ID)
create_ticket_by_type_id.description: Creates a ticket of a given ticket type for one contact.

contactValue.label: Contact
contactValue.description: The contact ID, email or external ID, matching Identify Contact By. An unknown email creates a new contact.

attributes.label: Other Attributes
attributes.description: Ticket type attributes by name, for example {"Priority": "<list option ID>", "Due": "2026-10-20T12:00:00Z"}.

companyId.label: Company ID
companyId.description: Optional Intercom company ID to link.

update_ticket_by_id.label: Update Ticket (by ID)
update_ticket_by_id.description: Changes a ticket's state, assignee, snooze time or attributes.

ticketId.label: Ticket ID
ticketId.description: The ticket "id" from Intercom, not the inbox ticket number.

snoozedUntil.label: Snooze Until
snoozedUntil.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, such as 2026-01-02T10:00:00Z.

assigneeId.label: Assignee Admin ID
assigneeId.description: Assign the ticket to this admin (see List Admins). Use 0 to unassign.

adminId.label: Acting Admin ID
adminId.description: The admin who makes the assignment. Leave empty to use the admin who owns this connection.

attributes.label: Attributes
attributes.description: Ticket attributes by name; null clears one. Dates take ISO 8601; list attributes take the option ID.

get_contact.label: Get Contact
get_contact.description: Gets one contact (user or lead) by ID, email or external ID.

value.label: Value
value.description: The contact ID, email or external ID.

search_contacts.label: Search Contacts
search_contacts.description: Finds contacts (users and leads) by email, name, tag, segment, update time or a custom attribute.

updatedAfter.label: Updated After
updatedAfter.description: Intercom compares dates by calendar day in your workspace time zone.

updatedBefore.label: Updated Before
updatedBefore.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, such as 2026-01-02T10:00:00Z.

customAttribute.label: Custom Attribute Name
customAttribute.description: Match contacts whose custom attribute equals Custom Attribute Value.

advancedQuery.label: Advanced Query
advancedQuery.description: Optional Intercom search filter, combined with the fields above using AND.

startingAfter.label: Starting After
startingAfter.description: The next_starting_after value from the previous page.

update_contact.label: Update Contact
update_contact.description: Updates a contact's role, email, name, phone, external ID, owner, subscription or custom attributes.

contactId.label: Contact ID
contactId.description: The Intercom contact ID (see Search Contacts or Get Contact).

customAttributes.label: Custom Attributes
customAttributes.description: Custom attributes by name. Only the ones you list change.

clearFields.label: Clear Fields
clearFields.description: Fields to blank on the contact. A JSON list of: name, phone, external_id, owner_id.

attach_contact_to_company.label: Attach Contact to Company
attach_contact_to_company.description: Links a contact to a company.

companyId.label: Intercom Company ID
companyId.description: The Intercom "id" of the company, not your own Company ID.

list_contact_notes.label: List Contact Notes
list_contact_notes.description: Lists the internal notes on a contact.

search_conversations.label: Search Conversations
search_conversations.description: Finds conversations by state, assignee, contact, tag, text or date.

bodyContains.label: First Message Contains
bodyContains.description: Intercom matches single words of the first message best.

createdAfter.label: Created After
createdAfter.description: Intercom compares dates by calendar day in your workspace time zone.

createdBefore.label: Created Before
createdBefore.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, such as 2026-01-02T10:00:00Z.

updatedAfter.label: Updated After
updatedAfter.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, such as 2026-01-02T10:00:00Z.

updatedBefore.label: Updated Before
updatedBefore.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, such as 2026-01-02T10:00:00Z.

advancedQuery.label: Advanced Query
advancedQuery.description: Optional Intercom search filter, combined with the fields above using AND.

startingAfter.label: Starting After
startingAfter.description: The next_starting_after value from the previous page.

set_conversation_state.label: Close, Reopen or Snooze Conversation
set_conversation_state.description: Closes, reopens or snoozes a conversation.

snoozedUntil.label: Snooze Until
snoozedUntil.description: Required for Snooze; must be in the future.

closingMessage.label: Closing Message
closingMessage.description: Optional, Close only. The customer sees this message.

adminId.label: Acting Admin ID
adminId.description: Leave empty to act as the admin who owns this connection.

convert_conversation_to_ticket.label: Convert Conversation to Ticket
convert_conversation_to_ticket.description: Turns a conversation into a ticket of the chosen ticket type.

attributes.label: Ticket Attributes
attributes.description: Optional attributes by name. Dates take ISO 8601; list attributes take the option ID.

get_ticket.label: Get Ticket
get_ticket.description: Gets one ticket by its ID.

ticketId.label: Ticket ID
ticketId.description: The ticket "id" from Intercom, not the inbox ticket number.

search_tickets.label: Search Tickets
search_tickets.description: Finds tickets by type, state, contact, assignee, title or date.

createdAfter.label: Created After
createdAfter.description: Intercom compares dates by calendar day in your workspace time zone.

createdBefore.label: Created Before
createdBefore.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, such as 2026-01-02T10:00:00Z.

updatedAfter.label: Updated After
updatedAfter.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, such as 2026-01-02T10:00:00Z.

updatedBefore.label: Updated Before
updatedBefore.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, such as 2026-01-02T10:00:00Z.

advancedQuery.label: Advanced Query
advancedQuery.description: Optional Intercom search filter, combined with the fields above using AND.

startingAfter.label: Starting After
startingAfter.description: The next_starting_after value from the previous page.

reply_to_ticket.label: Reply to Ticket
reply_to_ticket.description: Adds an admin reply or an internal note to a ticket.

ticketId.label: Ticket ID
ticketId.description: The ticket "id" from Intercom, not the inbox ticket number.

adminId.label: Admin ID
adminId.description: Leave empty to reply as the admin who owns this connection.

attachmentUrls.label: Attachment URLs
attachmentUrls.description: Up to 10 public image URLs to attach.

list_ticket_types.label: List Ticket Types
list_ticket_types.description: Lists ticket types with their attributes and list options.

list_admins.label: List Admins
list_admins.description: Lists the admins (teammates) in the workspace.

list_teams.label: List Teams
list_teams.description: Lists the teams in the workspace.
list_teams.afterResponse: return {items: (response.teams ?? []).map((team) => ({id: team.id, name: team.name ?? null, admin_ids: Array.isArray(team.admin_ids) ? team.admin_ids : []}))};

list_data_attributes.label: List Data Attributes
list_data_attributes.description: Lists the standard and custom attributes for contacts, companies or conversations.
list_data_attributes.afterResponse:
return {items: (response.data ?? []).map((attribute) => ({name: attribute.name, full_name: attribute.full_name ?? null, label: attribute.label ?? null, data_type: attribute.data_type ?? null,
  model: attribute.model ?? null, custom: attribute.custom === true, api_writable: attribute.api_writable === true, options: Array.isArray(attribute.options) ? attribute.options : []}))};

create_tag.label: Create Tag
create_tag.description: Creates a tag, or returns the existing tag with that name.
create_tag.afterResponse:
const name = inputs.name.trim();
return (response.data ?? []).find((tag) => String(tag.name ?? '').toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase()) ?? call({method: 'POST', url: '/tags', body: {name}});

get_company.label: Get Company
get_company.description: Gets one company by its Intercom ID or by your own Company ID.

list_companies.label: List Companies
list_companies.description: Lists companies, optionally only those with a tag or in a segment.

search_articles.label: Search Help Center Articles
search_articles.description: Searches Help Center articles for a phrase.

helpCenterId.label: Help Center ID
helpCenterId.description: Only needed when the workspace has several Help Centers.

list_segments.label: List Segments
list_segments.description: Lists the contact segments in the workspace.

includeCount.label: Include Counts
includeCount.description: Also return how many contacts are in each segment.

list_segments.afterResponse:
return {items: (response.segments ?? []).map((segment) => ({id: segment.id, name: segment.name ?? null, person_type: segment.person_type ?? null, count: segment.count ?? null,
  created_at: segment.created_at ?? null, updated_at: segment.updated_at ?? null}))};

add_note_to_contact.label: Add Note to Contact (by ID)
add_note_to_contact.description: Adds an internal note to a contact by contact ID.

body.label: Note Text
body.description: The note text. Simple HTML is allowed.

adminId.label: Author Admin ID
adminId.description: The admin shown as the author. Leave empty to use the admin who owns this connection.

create_conversation_from_contact.label: Create Conversation from Contact
create_conversation_from_contact.description: Starts a new conversation with a first message written as the contact.

contactId.label: Contact ID
contactId.description: The Intercom contact ID (user or lead).

body.label: Message Body
body.description: Plain text; HTML is not supported here.

create_help_center_article.label: Create Help Center Article
create_help_center_article.description: Creates a Help Center article, as a draft unless told to publish.

body.label: Body
body.description: The article content. HTML is allowed.

authorId.label: Author Admin ID
authorId.description: Leave empty to use the admin who owns this connection.

collectionId.label: Parent Collection ID
collectionId.description: The Help Center collection to put the article in. Leave empty for none.
